writeup: Woot's Sellout has the JOBY Compact Advanced full size tripod (JB01763) open box for $66.86. It has a 3-way pan head, holds up to 6.6 lb, extends to about 65 inches and folds down under 18 inches. Ace Photo sells it new for $149.95 and B&H for $174.99, so this is about 55% less, with a limit of 2 per customer.
